radio-fm 0.0.7 - Linux armhf

Source: https://github.com/itsuki-irratia/radio-rust/tree/v0.0.7
Source commit: 251775b
Rust target: armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf
Rust compiler: 1.89.0
C compiler: GCC 14.2.0
Build system: Debian 13 (trixie), glibc 2.41
Linked against: GStreamer 1.26.2 and GLib 2.84.4
SQLite: bundled via libsqlite3-sys 0.39.1
Build command: cargo build --locked --release --target armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf

Verification: --version, --help, and 34 release-profile tests passed under
QEMU user-mode emulation. Physical audio hardware was not tested.

Runtime: Debian 13 for this architecture, or a compatible Linux environment
with glibc, GLib/GIO, libgcc, GStreamer, and plugins for your audio formats.
These shared libraries are not included in this bundle.
Example runtime packages on Debian 13:
  sudo apt install libgstreamer1.0-0 libglib2.0-0t64 libgcc-s1 \
    gstreamer1.0-plugins-base gstreamer1.0-plugins-good \
    gstreamer1.0-plugins-bad gstreamer1.0-plugins-ugly gstreamer1.0-libav
See README.md for audio backend and optional Icecast dependencies.
